question: Newly introduced and difficult flashcards come back more often than old easy ones. What does the article give as the reason for that schedule?
options: To finish all difficult material before any of the easier material starts
To ensure every card in the collection is seen the same number of times

question: Ebbinghaus's 'forgetting curve' plots the loss of learned information over time. What did he postulate could curb that loss?
options: Studying the information for far longer during one single sitting
Learning related items together so that each one reinforces the others
Reviewing the information at several intervals over a period of time
Testing the information immediately after the very first exposure

acceptedAnswers: Psychology of Study by C. A. Mace
